verdict.rationale: Rev AI's asynchronous API docs state a maximum audio duration of 17 hours per job, so multi-hour recordings fit in a single job. They also document a 5 TB file size limit for uploads via the dashboard or the source_config parameter, and the format list covers anything FFmpeg supports. Missing for 10: a documented size limit for direct local/multipart API uploads (the 5 TB figure is scoped to dashboard and source_config), and independent or hands-on corroboration of long-file processing.
